purpose: Fifty prespecified GPU initialization attempts at N40, with all eight paired continuation methods.
seed_rule: Entire historical DeepSea N10 50-seed manifest, without outcome filtering; expansion seeds followed by original seeds. All 50 are acquired anew at N40 on GPU.
initialization: Unchanged randomized-prior bootstrapped DQN (20 heads), first LOW head-vote success in [0.05,0.15] within 5*N^3 environment steps; complete source run and original CPU policy/critic bridge with unchanged release gates.
metric: Expected return; normalized trapezoidal mean over 0..2048 actor updates.
configuration: All seven baseline recipes transferred unchanged from the N30 development selection. PDR uses the frozen SAC alpha=1,beta=32 configuration with the N30 CQL critic rule and entropy. No tuning at N40/N50.
comparison: Common starting actor/critic, replay support, actor batch schedule and actor update budget. Individual baseline objectives retained; PER samples critic records, 8xTD performs eight critic updates, PS has 64 planning backups per actor update.
reference: PDR-SAC uses an exact soft-policy reference and complete graph support, as in the completed N10-N30 paired study.
unavailable: Keep every attempted seed. Missing first LOW within budget or failed original bridge interface gate makes that start unavailable for all methods. No replacement seeds, relaxed bands or later checkpoint selection. Numerical/implementation failures stop the queue.
evidence: Fixed-configuration N40 scale extension. Report every initialization attempt and all available paired continuations; no top-seed subset.
checkpoint_policy: Complete original source DQN checkpoints and complete initial/progress/final model, optimizer, target, RNG and planner states retained on sdc1.
engineering: N40 GPU graph-interface, soft-differential and exact checkpoint-resume checks before formal jobs; every continuation checks one-step complete-state replay.

execution.distribution: Fill all free GPUs before adding workers; physical CPU core per worker.
execution.foreign_processes: Wait on occupied cards; never terminate other jobs.

device_amendment: User authorized all eight GPUs for the 50-seed N40 extension. Source acquisition and continuations use GPU; original distillation bridge remains CPU. Prior CPU pilot is retained separately and not pooled into this cohort.
